content.value: Determine annual soil (silt loam) loss from an upland farm of 1000 acres in (10) Khulna (Rainfall Erosivity Factor is 200). The slope length is 500 feet with 2 percent slope steepness (topographic factor is 0.326). The soil is covered with matured grass (0.004) and relative erodibilities of silt loam soils is 0.33.
